primitives.name: Adaptive Multimodal Fusion
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Verdict:** ADAPT **Rationale:** Progressive Adaptive Multimodal Fusion Network (PAMFN): separate modality-specific branches + a mixed-modality branch with an Adaptive Fusion Module (PolicyNet choosing among ranked FusionNets per video segment).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{mixed}}^{t}': 'Mixed modality feature vector at time t (dimension 256)', '\\mathcal{A}_{\\text{PolicyNet}}': 'Adaptive fusion policy function (ranked selection of FusionNets)', '\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{RGB}}^{t}': 'RGB modality feature vector at time t', '\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{Flow}}^{t}': 'Optical flow modality feature vector at time t', '\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{Audio}}^{t}': 'Audio modality feature vector at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Modalities are temporally aligned; fusion policy is learned from training data; feature dimensions are consistent across modalities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When modality-specific features are insufficient or noisy, adaptive fusion may degrade performance.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian belief update where \mathcal{A}_{\text{PolicyNet}} acts as a probabilistic selector of evidence streams.
layer2.telemetry: Spearman correlation between predicted and referee scores.

primitives.name: Negative Attention Decoder
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Modality-specific Feature Decoder**: cross-attention with query = mixed features, key/value = concatenated modality features, using NEGATIVE attention softmax(-QKT/√d)V to extract the least-similar (i.e., unseen/neglected) information.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{unseen}}': 'Unseen modality information extracted via negative attention (dimension 256)', 'Q': 'Query matrix derived from mixed features', 'K': 'Key matrix from concatenated modality features', 'V': 'Value matrix from concatenated modality features', 'd': 'Feature dimension (256)'}
primitives.assumptions: Attention mechanism is symmetric; negative softmax emphasizes dissimilar features.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When modality features are highly correlated, negative attention may fail to extract meaningful differences.

layer2.mapping: Derives kernel for identifying modality redundancy in GSE's multi-source sensor fusion.
layer2.telemetry: Information gain from least-similar modality features.

primitives.name: PolicyNet Decision Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Verdict:** ADAPT **Rationale:** Progressive Adaptive Multimodal Fusion Network (PAMFN): separate modality-specific branches + a mixed-modality branch with an Adaptive Fusion Module (PolicyNet choosing among ranked FusionNets per video segment).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{A}_{\\text{PolicyNet}}': 'Decision function selecting optimal modality fusion strategy', '\\mathcal{F}_i': 'Individual modality feature vector', '\\text{Spearman}': 'Rank correlation coefficient (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Referee scores are valid ground truth; Spearman correlation is sufficient for ranking strategies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If referee scores are biased or inconsistent, PolicyNet will select suboptimal fusion strategies.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation of PAMFN lies in progressive adaptive fusion, where modality-specific features are processed separately before being combined through a learned policy. The system uses a hybrid approach: RGB and flow features are pre-trained and frozen, while audio is fine-tuned due to its limited standalone utility. A key novelty is the use of negative attention in the decoder to extract dissimilar information, enhancing diversity in fusion. The PolicyNet dynamically chooses the best fusion strategy per segment, enabling temporal adaptability. This contrasts with naive weighted fusion which often underperforms unimodal models. The method is validated on rhythmic gymnastics and figure skating datasets, showing superior Spearman correlations compared to baseline fusion techniques. The architecture supports efficient inference (33 ms) and is scalable to other domains like NFL play assessment with appropriate adaptations.
